terms.definition: The number of nuclei that decay per unit time, A = λN, in becquerels.
The probability that a nucleus will decay per unit time.
terms.examiner: λt½ = ln 2. Unit s⁻¹ (or any time unit, used consistently).

terms.definition: The average time taken for half the active nuclei in a sample to decay (or for the activity to halve).
It is impossible to predict when a particular nucleus will decay.
terms.examiner: Shown by fluctuations in the count rate.

terms.definition: Decay is not affected by external conditions such as temperature or pressure, or by the presence of other nuclei.
